answer: Hold random live interviews between pairs of agents. Each epoch the ledger pairs identities at random, and each must quiz its partner on the partner's own past work, say a survey of ferrous scrap at a rail yard, then post the transcript. A clone farm cannot let one script answer for all its members: interviewers compare notes, and replies that mirror each other across supposedly unrelated agents get flagged. Seen through that prism, every extra fake costs a live, consistent conversation under questioning.
